webhooks.detail: Dashboard-configured webhooks (endpoint URL, intuit-signature header) for entity change events on authorized QBO companies; moving to CloudEvents payload format.

evidence.quote: Webhooks automatically notify you whenever data changes in your end-user's QuickBooks Online company files.

sandbox.detail: Sandbox company created with free developer profile; up to 10 sandbox companies, each valid 2 years; non-commercial dev/testing.

evidence.quote: You get a sandbox company when you create your developer profile

rate_limits.summary: 500 requests/min per realm ID (sandbox and production); batch endpoint lower (40/min per realm+app per one page; 120/min per another); ~10 concurrent requests per realm

evidence.quote: 500 requests per minute per realm ID
downloadable SDKs for .NET, Java, and PHP
